attributesRaw.name: productLongDescription
attributesRaw.value:
The Tomasi Series 09 Flute combines high-quality craftsmanship with an affordable price, designed for developing players passionate about their art. Featuring a genuine Silver Light (.835) sterling silver headjoint, the Series 09 produces an open, centered tone perfect for solo and ensemble playing. Choose between three distinct lip plate options - sterling silver, rich grenadilla wood or lustrous 14K gold - to customize the flute's appearance and subtle tonal nuances.

Silver Light Headjoint Unlocks the Flute's Expressive Potential
The Silver Light (.835) headjoint is precision crafted from sterling silver, known for producing a focused, resonant tone. Its tapered profile and medium-wide embouchure hole offer nimble response and tonal control across the range of the flute. The headjoint's sterling silver composition helps produce the flute's characteristic bright, pure timbre, ideal for solo and small ensemble work.

Three Distinct Lip Plates Provide Unique Tonal Colors
Choose between a sterling silver, grenadilla wood or 14K gold lip plate to subtly influence the flute's tone and customize its appearance. The sterling silver lip plate produces a bright, centered tone. Grenadilla wood adds warmth and depth. 14K gold contributes a touch of brilliance and richness to the sound. Each lip plate is made to exacting standards to seamlessly pair with the Silver Light headjoint.
Ergonomic Mechanism Promotes Fluid Fingering
Low-profile pointed key arms, offset G key and sculpted keys are designed for comfortable, intuitive fingering. The pointed key arms have a narrow profile, reducing the reach between keys. The offset G key positions the G key slightly forward, allowing for a more natural hand position. Well-balanced, sculpted keys with teardrop-shaped paddles rest comfortably under the fingers, promoting an effortless playing experience for budding flutists.
Premium Accessories Complete the Package
The Series 09 Flute includes a plush-lined lightweight case to protect the flute during travel and storage. Additional accessories like a cleaning rod, cleaning cloth and cork grease ensure proper instrument care and maintenance. With premium craftsmanship and an array of professional features, the Tomasi Series 09 Flute is an outstanding choice for the developing flutist. Order the Tomasi Series 09 Flute today.
